quickref.name: Space Oddity
quickref.era: BBR 1.0 launch map as 'Spacecraft' (wiki date Oct 8, 2011) [Fan-wiki]. Renamed 'Space Oddity' for BBG: launch May 24, 2013, page moved Jun 4, new tile Jun 15, 2013 [Fan-wiki; timing Inference]. BBR fixes: Huggable spawn-suicide bug (v1.4) and Mini Me glitch (1.4.2, Feb 28, 2013) [Fan-wiki]. Game-wide 'New Map Lighting' in v3.0 (Nov 15, 2021) [Game text via wiki]
quickref.in_2026: Named by SkyVu on Steam as a returning 'Iconic Map' [Canon]. OST track 6 'Space Oddity' (0:54) [Canon]. Shown in Steam screenshot screen_01 and the Steam trailer at about 30.0-32.6 s [Observed]. Its 2013 tile is row 3, col 3 of the 16-map grid in the official short 'BBG Maps Ranked part 1' [Observed]. Not in any 2026 Steam news post. Modes on this map, and any 2026 relighting, unknown
quickref.setting: A compact, enclosed spaceship interior in space [Observed; Fan-wiki 'Indoor']. Amber-tinted window walls show stars, and a base window shows a blazing white star [Observed]. Fan glitch footage from outside shows the hull, a blue-white planet and a starfield [Observed]. Whose ship is undocumented. The pink Huggable-faced crates and 'CRYO' pods hint at the Huggable/H.I.P. side [Inference]
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Warm amber vs cool cyan, matte, mid-saturation. Window glass #7B3006 to #E68F1E. Bulkheads #403114. Grey-green catwalks #48665A/#61764F. Back walls #3C4530. Pillar near-black olive #1F2010 with mustard chevrons #80700E. Floor tan #AD924B with ochre inlays #A57230. Cyan lights #35DAEE and glows #FCFFFD. Crates #2D3C35 with pink faces #B15E68. Tile: cream-olive #868448, yellow trim #DDDE00. Amber light shafts slant through the windows; cyan ring lights, pipes and pads; no time of day [Observed]
quickref.landmarks: 1) Central octagonal olive pillar with a glowing white-cyan top under a cyan ring-light ceiling emitter and cone beam; Bearscream Sandwich on top, 4 jump pads around it. 2) Long amber star-window walls with two tiers of grey-green catwalks ('bridges' to the bases). 3) Corner stacks of charcoal crates with pink grinning Huggable faces (Engineer turret nest). 4) Two-level bases at each end: consoles under a giant window, and a yellow-edged floor opening down to a basement of 'CRYO' pods. 5) Yellow-framed octagonal doorways and orange glowing alcoves [Observed; Fan-wiki]
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No environmental hazards documented ('Suicide = No'); 7+ jump pads (3 per base, 4 at centre); explosives can breach the basement; a fan-reported explosive-damage bug above the pillar [Fan-wiki]. Pickups: Bearscream Sandwich at centre, 2 Imperial Basket Grandes under the side decks, 2 Health Packs, Shields; in PTB both bombs start at centre and tubes sit at the spawns [Fan-wiki]. Easter eggs: a wireframe 'Death Star' hologram [Observed]; a boss hologram that the wiki calls Mecha-Bearzerker on one page and Spaceboss on another [Fan-wiki, conflicting, unseen]; the name likely nods to Bowie's 'Space Oddity' [Fan-wiki/Inference]; So Fly + Mini Me reach outside to see the ship [Fan-wiki]. The laser and garbage chute in a 2014 wiki edit belong to Shortest Parsec

corrections.current_text: - **The H.I.P. logo** (a Vitruvian-style Huggable in a circle) appears on Space Oddity [Observed: Steam screen_02].
corrections.correction: Replace 'Space Oddity' with 'Shortest Parsec'. Steam screen_02 is Shortest Parsec. Space Oddity is screen_01, an amber, olive and cyan interior with no H.I.P. logo seen.
corrections.evidence: screen_02.jpg shows a red and white station in open space with red H.I.P. floor discs. That matches the wiki tile File:Shortest_Parsec.png (maps/dl/shortest_parsec/orig/Shortest_Parsec_icon.png) and Steam trailer t_0100-t_0104. Space Oddity's tile (File:Space_Oddity.png) and its trailer shot (30.0-32.6 s, the same set-up as screen_01) are enclosed amber, olive and cyan interiors.

corrections.current_text: **Space Oddity**: a small, symmetrical, yellow-themed spaceship map (originally "Spacecraft") with a hologram of the Mecha-Bearzerker.
corrections.correction: "a small, symmetrical spaceship interior in amber-orange, olive and cyan (originally 'Spacecraft', a BBR 1.0 launch map). The wiki's hologram claims conflict: the Space Oddity and Bearzerker pages say Mecha-Bearzerker; the Spaceboss page says Spaceboss; the only hologram image on the map page is a wireframe 'Death Star' sphere. Hologram subject: Unverified."
corrections.evidence: Wiki Space Oddity trivia; Bearzerker page trivia; Spaceboss page trivia ('A hologram of Spaceboss can be seen in the map Space Oddity in Battle Bears Gold'); File:Death_Star.jpg (opened: cyan wireframe sphere with a dish); Steam trailer frame at 30.0 s and screen_01 for the palette.

corrections.correction: 'Interior' is now supported and can be restored. The map is an enclosed spaceship interior.
corrections.evidence: Every official view I opened is enclosed, with ceilings, bulkheads and window walls: Steam screen_01, Steam trailer 30.0-32.6 s, BBG map tile File:Space_Oddity.png. The wiki's first infobox (revision 16502, 2012-11-28) gives 'Type = Indoor'. The wiki renders Spacecraft1-3.jpg are captioned 'Spaceship Level'.

corrections.current_text: Interiors are glossy white and red sci-fi, there are lava/orange caverns and rocky caves
corrections.correction: Add that the Steam screenshots also include a matte amber-orange, olive and cyan spaceship interior: Space Oddity, screen_01 and trailer about 30-32.6 s. The glossy white and red interiors are Shortest Parsec (screen_02, screen_04) and the white and pink lab (screen_00).
corrections.evidence: Pixel samples from trailer frame 30.0 s (maps/dl/space_oddity/frames/hi/so_004.jpg): window glass #7B3006/#E68F1E, catwalk #48665A, pillar #1F2010, floor #AD924B, cyan #35DAEE. Compare the red and white Shortest Parsec tile and screen_02.
